agreement.title: 1. Agreement to Terms
agreement.p1: By accessing and using the FanIndex website, platform, and services (collectively, the "Platform"), you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations. If you do not agree with any of these terms, you are prohibited from using or accessing this Platform.
agreement.p2: These terms apply to all users of the Platform, including investors, visitors, and any other persons who access or use the service.

platform.title: 2. Platform Description
platform.p1: FanIndex is a decentralized SportFi infrastructure platform built on the Chiliz Chain. The Platform enables users to gain diversified exposure to Fan Token ecosystems through professionally structured, tokenized index products.
platform.p2: FanIndex provides the following core services:
ul1: Tokenized sports indices composed of Fan Tokens
On-chain portfolio infrastructure and position tracking
Fan Token market analytics and real-time price data
platform.p3: All index operations, including purchases and redemptions, are executed transparently on the Chiliz Chain via smart contracts. The Platform does not custody assets in a traditional financial sense — all positions are held on-chain and represented by NFTs.

investmentProcess.title: 3. Investment Process
investmentProcess.p1: When a user invests in a FanIndex product, the following process occurs automatically via smart contract:
ul1: CHZ is deposited into the protocol by the user
Smart contracts execute proportional purchases of the underlying Fan Tokens
Fan Tokens are held by the protocol treasury on-chain
A unique NFT representing the position is minted to the investor's wallet
investmentProcess.p2: Redemptions are processed by burning the position NFT, after which the underlying portfolio is liquidated and CHZ is returned to the investor. There is no exit fee on redemptions.
investmentProcess.p3: A 1% protocol entry fee is applied to all purchases. Actively managed index products may carry an additional annualized management fee of 1–2% as disclosed on the relevant product page.

indexMethodology.title: 4. Index Methodology
indexMethodology.p1: FanIndex indices are constructed using a transparent, rules-based methodology. The value of each index is calculated using a weighted pricing model applied to real-time market prices sourced from CoinGecko and other market data providers.
indexMethodology.p2: Indices may be structured as market-cap weighted, equal-weight, or actively managed products. The applicable methodology is disclosed on each product's individual page.
indexMethodology.p3: Indices are periodically rebalanced to maintain target allocations. Rebalancing is currently executed manually by the FanIndex team. Future protocol versions may introduce automated smart contract rebalancing and DAO governance mechanisms.
indexMethodology.p4: FanIndex reserves the right to update index methodologies, add or remove constituents, and adjust rebalancing schedules in accordance with market conditions and protocol improvements. Material changes will be disclosed to users.

risks.title: 5. Risk Disclosures
risks.p1: Investing in Fan Token indices involves significant risk. You should carefully consider the following risk factors before using the Platform:
ul1: Market Volatility: Fan Tokens are highly volatile digital assets. The value of index positions may fluctuate substantially and may decline to zero.
Liquidity Risk: Some Fan Tokens within an index may experience periods of low liquidity, which may affect the ability to rebalance or redeem positions at expected prices.
Smart Contract Risk: Despite security audits and multisig treasury management, smart contracts may contain vulnerabilities.
Regulatory Risk: Digital asset regulations continue to evolve globally. Changes in applicable laws may impact the availability of FanIndex services in certain jurisdictions.
Concentration Risk: Individual index products are concentrated in the Fan Token ecosystem and are not diversified across broader asset classes.
risks.p2: You should only invest amounts you can afford to lose entirely. FanIndex does not provide investment advice.

eligibility.title: 6. User Eligibility
eligibility.p1: By using the Platform, you represent and warrant that you are of legal age in your jurisdiction to enter into binding contracts, and that your use of the Platform does not violate any applicable laws or regulations in your jurisdiction.
eligibility.p2: The Platform is not available to persons located in jurisdictions where decentralized finance products, digital assets, or blockchain-based financial instruments are restricted or prohibited. You are solely responsible for ensuring compliance with local laws.
eligibility.p3: FanIndex reserves the right to restrict access to the Platform in any jurisdiction at any time without prior notice.

nftPositions.title: 7. NFT Position Certificates
nftPositions.p1: Each investment position in a FanIndex product is represented by a unique NFT minted to your wallet. The NFT contains the following on-chain data:
ul1: Proportional allocation data at time of purchase
nftPositions.p2: The NFT acts as proof of ownership, a portfolio certificate, and a redeemable claim on the underlying assets. Transfer of the NFT constitutes transfer of the underlying position.

intellectualProperty.title: 8. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.p1: All content on the FanIndex Platform, including but not limited to index methodologies, brand assets, interface designs, documentation, and software, is the proprietary intellectual property of FanIndex and its licensors.
intellectualProperty.p2: Permission is granted to access and use the Platform for personal, non-commercial purposes only.

disclaimers.title: 9. Disclaimers
disclaimers.p1: The Platform and its services are provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied. FanIndex expressly disclaims all warranties.
disclaimers.p2: Nothing on the Platform constitutes financial, investment, legal, or tax advice. You should consult independent professional advisers before making any investment decisions.

limitation.title: 10. Limitation of Liability
limitation.p1: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, FanIndex, its founders, contributors, partners, and affiliates shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of or inability to use the Platform.

governance.title: 11. Protocol Governance
governance.p1: FanIndex plans to introduce decentralized governance mechanisms in future protocol versions, allowing the community to participate in index proposals, methodology adjustments, treasury decisions, and ecosystem expansion.

modifications.title: 12. Modifications to Terms
modifications.p1: FanIndex reserves the right to modify these Terms of Service at any time. Updated terms will be posted to this page with a revised effective date. Continued use of the Platform following any modification constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Contact our support team.
faq.q1: How do indices work on FanIndex?
faq.a1: FanIndex indices are collections of carefully selected crypto assets with weighted allocations. Each index tracks the combined value of its constituents and rebalances monthly to maintain target weights. Positions are backed by NFTs representing verifiable ownership.
faq.a2: Entry Fee: 1% when buying in. Exit Fee: 0%. Management Fee: Only for managed indices (1-2% annually). Weighted and equal-weight indices have no management fees. Performance Fee: 20% of gains above benchmark (for managed indices only). All fees are transparent and deducted automatically.
faq.a3: Indices rebalance monthly on a set schedule. Rebalancing ensures allocations stay true to targets and removes underperforming assets. You're notified before each rebalancing, and all transactions are recorded on-chain.
faq.a4: Yes. All smart contracts are independently audited. We use multi-signature wallets for treasury management and Chainlink oracles for price feeds. Your NFT positions represent real on-chain ownership backed by underlying assets.
faq.a5: Yes, you can withdraw instantly anytime with zero exit fees. Redeem your position and receive CHZ or Fan tokens according to your preference. Withdrawals are processed immediately on-chain. No lockup period or restrictions.
faq.a6: The minimum investment is 100 CHZ. There's no maximum limit. You can buy fractional positions of any index.
faq.q7: Can I create my own custom index?
faq.a7: Not yet. Custom index creation is planned for a future release. Currently, you can invest in pre-built indices created by FanIndex. We're working on enabling community-created indices, which will allow you to design and share custom allocations.
faq.a8: Index prices (NAV) are calculated using the formula: NAV = Σ(wᵢ × Pᵢ), where wᵢ is the weight of asset i and Pᵢ is its current price in CHZ. Prices update in real-time with market data.

executiveSummary.p1: FanIndex is a decentralized SportFi infrastructure platform built on the Chiliz Chain that transforms Fan Tokens into structured, index-based financial products.
executiveSummary.p2: Instead of manually buying and managing individual Fan Tokens, users can gain diversified exposure to entire segments of the ecosystem through professionally structured indices.
executiveSummary.p4: Each index position is represented by a unique NFT that certifies ownership of the underlying basket of assets.
executiveSummary.p5: When users invest into an index:
ul5: CHZ is deposited into the protocol
Smart contracts execute proportional purchases of the underlying Fan Tokens
Tokens are held by the protocol treasury
An NFT representing the position is minted to the investor
ul6: Organic liquidity generation across the Chiliz ecosystem
executiveSummary.p7: FanIndex is designed to become the financial infrastructure layer for Fan Tokens.

vision.p1: Fan Tokens introduced digital ownership and engagement for sports communities.
vision.p2: FanIndex expands that model by introducing financial infrastructure around the ecosystem.
ul3: The benchmark indices of the Fan Token market
The portfolio infrastructure for SportFi investors
The analytics layer for Fan Token capital markets
The gateway between sports fandom and decentralized finance
vision.p4: FanIndex aims to make Fan Tokens investable, trackable, and structurally accessible for both retail and institutional participants.

marketContext.p1: Fan Tokens, pioneered by Chiliz and Socios.com, created a new category of blockchain-based sports assets.
ul2: Billions in cumulative trading volume have been generated
Global clubs, national teams, esports organizations, and combat sports brands participate in the ecosystem
marketContext.p3: Fan Tokens established the foundation for SportFi. However, financial infrastructure around these assets remains extremely limited.
ul4: Fragmented Exposure: Investors must manually purchase and manage multiple individual Fan Tokens.
Lack of Structured Products: There are currently no benchmark indices or diversified financial instruments for the ecosystem.
Limited Portfolio Infrastructure: Most platforms focus exclusively on trading rather than portfolio construction and analytics.
Volatility Concentration: Single-token exposure creates significant volatility and risk concentration.
Underdeveloped Capital Markets: Fan Tokens have engagement utility but limited financial infrastructure.
marketContext.p4: Traditional finance evolved through ETFs, indices, portfolio products, and structured exposure. Crypto adopted these concepts across DeFi, Layer 1 ecosystems, AI tokens, and meme indices.
marketContext.p5: Fan Tokens remain one of the last major crypto verticals without index infrastructure. FanIndex fills that gap.

platform.p1: FanIndex is a decentralized platform for:
platform.p2: The platform combines index products, NFT portfolio infrastructure, market analytics, and on-chain transparency into a single ecosystem.
ul2: Tokenized Indices: Structured baskets of Fan Tokens grouped by theme, geography, category, or strategy.
NFT-Based Positions: Every investment position is represented by an NFT.
Portfolio Tracking: Users can monitor positions, allocations, exposure, and performance directly on-chain.
Fan Token Analytics: Real-time market data including price, market cap, volume, circulating supply, and performance metrics for the entire Fan Token ecosystem.
On-Chain Infrastructure: All transactions occur transparently on the Chiliz Chain.

indexArchitecture.p1: FanIndex indices are designed to provide diversified exposure across specific segments of the Fan Token market.
indexArchitecture.p2: Weighted indices allocate assets proportionally based on market relevance. Factors may include market capitalization, liquidity, and ecosystem importance. These products function similarly to traditional market-cap weighted indices.
indexArchitecture.p3: Example — FTLX (Fan Token Leaders Index): The benchmark index of the Fan Token market, tracking the largest and most liquid Fan Tokens.
indexArchitecture.p4: Equal-weight indices allocate the same exposure to every constituent. This approach reduces concentration risk, increases diversification, and gives equal representation across organizations.
indexArchitecture.p5: Examples: FGMX (Fan Gaming Index), FFLX (Fan Fight Index).
indexArchitecture.p6: Managed indices introduce active portfolio management. The FanIndex team may rebalance dynamically, rotate exposure, and manage allocations strategically. Managed products are designed for advanced investors seeking tactical exposure.

ul: FTLX — Fan Token Leaders Index: The benchmark index of the Fan Token market. Tracks the largest and most liquid Fan Tokens representing the overall ecosystem.
FGMX — Fan Gaming Index: An equal-weight index focused on esports organizations with Fan Tokens.
FFLX — Fan Fight Index: An equal-weight index focused on combat sports organizations.
FELX — Fan English League Index: Tracks leading English football clubs with Fan Tokens.
FSLX — Fan Spanish League Index: Tracks leading Spanish football clubs represented in the ecosystem.
